overall.summary: All numbers and every rule statement reproduce, including an exhaustive check over the 432 configurations; nothing refuted or weakened.

commands: uv run python -m explaneat verify recheck experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-5718a4
uv run python -m explaneat verify recheck experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-5718a4
uv run python -m explaneat verify recheck experiments/verifier_bench/items/vb-5718a4

findings.statement: predicts exactly two of {a1,a2,a3,a4,a6}, preferably a5 != 1; train acc 0.887, AUC 0.925
findings.evidence: positive in 0 of 144 configs with <=1 first values, 136 of 152 with exactly two, 0 of 136 with >=3; AUC 0.9254, acc 0.887
commands: uv run python scratchpad/enum_monk.py vb-5718a4 out.json  (all 432 configurations through the verify model API: hold_row/set_raw/evaluate)

findings.statement: 113/114 positive when a5 != 1, 23/38 when a5 = 1; pairs (a2,a3) and (a3,a4) always fail; agreement 96.3% with count5==2 and 88.0% with the two-of-six rule; misses all 28 two-of-six cases with a5=1, accepts 23 of 38 three-of-six with a5=1
findings.evidence: 113/114; 23/38; (a2,a3) 0/4 and (a3,a4) 0/4; agreement 0.963 and 0.880; 0 of 28; 23 of 38: all reproduce
commands: uv run python scratchpad/enum_monk.py vb-5718a4 out.json  (all 432 configurations through the verify model API: hold_row/set_raw/evaluate)

findings.statement: holds the typical case down; moving a1, a3 or a6 off its first value lifts it; a2 or a4 first value brings it back
findings.evidence: the veto acts on exactly the 112 rows with three or more first values among a1,a2,a3,a4,a6 (mean contribution -69.7); the typical case has three (a1, a3, a6), so removing one lifts it and adding a2 or a4 restores it
